analysis_model.B_F: Q(ETOT)+B_TS+gamma_3*(|ETOT|+|TS|+|lambda*Tr(WP)|)+B_lambda_trace; reconstruct F from ETOT/TS and protocol external term, so no Q(F token).
analysis_model.B_TS: Join eigenvalue, occupation and k-weight raw rows exactly once by global k and full band index; reject gaps, duplicates, missing rows or inconsistent per-k weights. Spin is encoded in the complete band table. Capture writer and fermi_dirac_entropy call same fermi_dirac_occupation on the same eigenvalue/EF/effective-kT table. HP entropy uses raw occupation and weight token intervals through h(f), with h(0)=h(1)=0 and h<=ln(2). Multiply by source temperature K and exact binary64 source kB=6.3336814e-6. B_TS=Q(TS)+abs(TS_logged-HP_center)+interval radius+100/160-digit Decimal enclosure. The TS center discrepancy captures production entropy/log/summation without assumed libm gamma. Bind expected_n_kpoints and exact expected_band_indices from run metadata; source/self.f90 emits the full eigenvalues(ib,ik) loop, where ib is the global spin-inclusive band row.
analysis_model.analysis_arithmetic: Outward round positive bounds; include gamma guards through uF, centered D subtraction/division, exact decimal-to-binary h discrepancy, Richardson combinations, h2 X/Y and residual, truncation estimate and N_unc addition. Compare bias using exact Decimal subtraction of binary64 R_fine and g0. Add q_lambda*B_trace cross term.
analysis_model.decision_criterion: No changes to reviewed Richardson formulas or strict h2-resolution inequality; known h4 toy is expected to be INCONCLUSIVE under the presently frozen strict criterion pending any governance amendment.
analysis_model.domain_guard: Require captured global k indices == list(range(expected_n_kpoints)); source writes ig-1. Require expected band indices == list(range(nbands)); reject shifted, missing, duplicate, or extra indices.
analysis_model.gamma_verification: Before analysis, verify gamma_n >= n*eps/(1-n*eps) in Decimal arithmetic for n={1,2,3,4,64,128,256}; abort if any bound fails.
analysis_model.raw_assembler: Inventory phase verifies the frozen execution manifest and run-manifest-bound raw records.csv/stdout.log SHA-256 values without reading numeric contents. Assemble phase requires the inventory hash and rechecks every raw hash before token parsing. It preserves original ES24.16 strings for entropy/ETOT inputs, reconstructs P_ab=sum_kb weight*f*psi_a*conjg(psi_b) per spin from exact source basis_map/eigenvector rows, then sums spin blocks once. Every output carries source CSV/stdout/run-manifest hashes.
analysis_model.serialized_Q: For every raw e24.16/ES24.16 token, Q is half the decimal quantum from mantissa digits and emitted exponent, including printed zero. Retain exact tokens.
analysis_model.synthetic_h2_check: Pure h2 polynomial must resolve within operation-derived bounds. D=g+10h^2+32h^4 with roundoff-scale bounds is INCONCLUSIVE_STOP under unchanged strict 4:1 criterion; this is a premeasurement synthetic check only.
analysis_model.table_binding: Expected k count, exact zero-based global k-index vector 0..N_k-1, and exact zero-based global band-index vector are explicit per-run input fields bound to source capture dimensions. Trace keys must equal these exact ranges; source band_index is the global spin-inclusive eigenvalue row.
analysis_model.ug0: abs(Tr(W1*(P_tight-P_standard))) + gamma_256*sum abs(W1_ij)*(|P_standard_ji|+|P_tight_ji|) + sum abs(W1_ij)*(P_bound_standard_ji+P_bound_tight_ji), using both matrix scales.
